questions.title: 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus Mini-assessment

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: What must happen when the pointer moves onto hover-triggered content?

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: When may content stop being persistent?
choices: When the trigger is removed, it is dismissed, or information becomes invalid

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: What is an exception to dismissibility?

answer_key.q_2: When the trigger is removed, it is dismissed, or information becomes invalid

explanations.q_2: These are the stated persistence conditions.
explanations.q_3: Input error content has a dismissibility exception.
